verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Raw Event Export API that returns all event data, with all properties, as JSONL, plus the Engage API for user profiles and UI CSV exports. A community member independently calls the export policy 'great', so the core of exporting your data in open formats is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: evidence that session replays, dashboards and report definitions, and cohorts can also be exported, and documentation of a complete account-exit or bulk export-to-warehouse path.
